title: WHO-5 Well-Being Index
description: 5 positively worded statements about the past two weeks, each rated 0–5.

holder.name: World Health Organization (Psychiatric Research Unit, Mental Health Centre North Zealand)

citation.text: Topp CW, Østergaard SD, Søndergaard S, Bech P (2015). The WHO-5 Well-Being Index: a systematic review of the literature. Psychotherapy and Psychosomatics 84(3):167–176.

scoring.text: Raw sum (0–25) multiplied by 4 (0–100); 50 or below screens for low mood, 28 or below suggests depression. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.
